avoid_dishes.reason: Often seasoned with oyster or soy sauce. Ask.

name: Charm Thai
questions: Is the curry paste and fish sauce free of wheat, and is any soy or oyster sauce added?
Can pad thai be made with tamari and no oyster sauce?
Is the satay marinade made with regular soy sauce?
Do fried items share a fryer with battered food?

safe_dishes.dish: Thai curry made GF on request
safe_dishes.note: An FMGF reviewer had a curry made GF. Ask about shrimp paste and soy or oyster sauce.

summary: There's no GF menu, but an undated FMGF review reports a curry adapted to GF, and a hotel directory tags it gluten-free. It's worth a phone call.
